newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TAG Heuer confident on sales, profit.
newsitem.headline: TAG Heuer confident on sales, profit.

text.p: Swiss watchmaker TAG Heuer International SA said it was pleased with its results in the first nine months of 1996 and expected net sales and net income would continue to rise.

"We are pleased with our results in the first nine months of the year. In spite of difficult economic conditions in certain major markets, net sales are in line with expectations and we believe this trend will continue," chief executive Christian Viros said in a statement.
Nine-month net sales rose 9.8 percent to 318.7 million Swiss francs.

"The success of our new products has been particularly encouraging," he added, citing very strong demand for its 2000 series in the third quarter and enthusiastic initial reaction to its Carrera watch introduced in September.
TAG Heuer used part of the 300.8 million francs in net proceeds from its public share offer to cut its long-term debt net of excess cash to around 130 million francs, it said.

"We are confident that we now have a solid financial position that will enable us to further develop our traditional strengths and to achieve continued growth in both our net sales and net income," Viros said.
